operational_specification.population: random seeds for UCI HAR training runs
operational_specification.intervention: Server-bound target blocks.0.attn.q_proj.weight has stored tensor shape (64, 64). Momentum Reset on Weight Norm Excursion
operational_specification.comparator: Identity no-op control: the same program with Momentum Reset on Norm Excursion replaced by an identity transform at the same fixed endpoint. The control computes the same quantities and applies them with a zero coefficient, so per-step compute and the random-number stream match the intervention exactly and only the studied factor is neutralised.

pseudocode: Initialize weight tensor W with shape [64, 64] and momentum buffer m with zeros shape [64, 64]
Compute gradient g = dL/dW with shape [64, 64]
Compute tentative momentum m_tent = 0.9 * m + g
Compute tentative weight W_tent = W - 0.05 * m_tent
If Intervention Active AND N_tent > tau:
Set m = g (Reset momentum history to current gradient)

Scope (server-owned): comparator arm — execute every step above in the same order with no step skipped, setting Momentum Reset on Norm Excursion's applied coefficient to zero so the transform is the identity. Optimizer state (including any momentum buffer), per-step compute and the random-number stream therefore evolve identically to the intervention arm, and only the studied factor is neutralised.
intervention_protocol.application_timing: per optimizer step after gradient computation
intervention_protocol.normalization_rule: Frobenius norm compared to fixed threshold
intervention_protocol.numerical_safeguards: epsilon=1e-8 added to norm calculation if needed
invariants: Momentum buffer shape matches weight shape [64, 64]
Threshold tau remains constant throughout training
Gradients flow through W to optimizer

operational_specification.failure_handling: If divergence (NaN loss), record outcome as 0.0 for both arms

operational_specification.decision_consequence: If supported, adopt momentum reset for out-of-distribution transformer training. If refuted, abandon norm-based momentum control. Scope (server-owned): this decision is licensed only for the calibrated testbed uci_har_small_transformer_v1 measured by its own held-out classification accuracy on its held-out cohort, and is not evidence about any other dataset, model family, or setting.
operational_specification.mechanistic_rationale: Momentum amplifies weight norm growth in directions of consistent gradient alignment. In out-of-distribution settings, this locks into subject-specific noise. Resetting momentum breaks this amplification loop without freezing weights.
alternative_hypotheses: Momentum reset disrupts convergence too frequently, harming training stability.
Weight norm is not the primary driver of out-of-distribution failure in this architecture.
boundary_conditions: Scope (server-owned): single calibrated testbed uci_har_small_transformer_v1 — UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (DOI 10.24432/C54S4K; raw inertial signals, 128-timestep windows over 9 channels; official subject-disjoint split of 7,352 training and 2,947 held-out windows); model PreNormTransformerEncoder(Linear(9,64) + learned positional embedding(128,64); 2 blocks, each LayerNorm(64) -> 4-head self-attention over 128 timesteps with q/k/v/out Linear(64,64) -> residual -> LayerNorm(64) -> Linear(64,128) -> ReLU -> Linear(128,64) -> residual; final LayerNorm(64), mean-pool over time, Linear(64,6)); evaluated as the official UCI HAR test split — 2,947 windows recorded from 9 subjects who appear in no training window, so the held-out cohort is subject-disjoint rather than a random row split, and is never used for training or tuning
For each seed, both conditions use identical initialization, data split/order, stochastic draws, hyperparameters, tuning, update count, and compute budget.
Model and optimizer state are reset independently for each condition; no trained state is carried between paired runs.
negative_controls: Random momentum reset at fixed probability p=0.05 per step
leakage_risks: Threshold computed from init weights only
No test data used in threshold calculation
operational_specification.primary_outcome: held-out classification accuracy: number of correct activity predictions / 2947 windows in the official subject-disjoint UCI HAR test split; unit=proportion; range=[0, 1]; computed once per seeded run; higher is better; failure handling: If divergence (NaN loss), record outcome as 0.0 for both arms
operational_specification.estimand: Hypothesis-positive paired contrast H_s = outcome_intervention - outcome_comparator; estimand = arithmetic mean of H_s over the preregistered primary seed IDs.
operational_specification.sample_size_rationale: Prospective paired normal approximation with two-sided alpha=0.05: planning SD(H_s)=0.0250196 proportion, worthwhile effect=0.0125098, target power=0.90, required n=43; fixed n=43. Planning-SD basis: Immutable calibration record ef4188ff-a4a8-4720-a3a7-f59d889d0c94; baseline-only paired-null bootstrap UCL80 under recipe sha256:94f3ad0aa281d8b6845da79f0abcea1cd604a36c8b00ffcce5861e16cc4ff155. Worthwhile-effect basis: Versioned policy accuracy_fraction_v1 in proportion: max(absolute floor 0.005, fixed SD multiplier).
operational_specification.decision_value: Using the two-sided paired-bootstrap 95% CI for mean(H_s), support the preregistered directional effect only when CI_low > 0.0125098; refute that directional effect when CI_high <= 0; otherwise report inconclusive. The paired sign-flip p-value is descriptive and does not replace this decision rule. Decision consequence: If supported, adopt momentum reset for out-of-distribution transformer training. If refuted, abandon norm-based momentum control. Scope (server-owned): this decision is licensed only for the calibrated testbed uci_har_small_transformer_v1 measured by its own held-out classification accuracy on its held-out cohort, and is not evidence about any other dataset, model family, or setting.
falsification_criteria: Refute the preregistered directional effect when the two-sided paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint for mean(H_s) is <= 0.
Do not claim a worthwhile directional effect unless that CI's lower endpoint exceeds the fixed margin 0.0125098 proportion.
